newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-SPARTAK KEEP LEAD, DYNAMO MOSCOW STUMBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTAK KEEP LEAD, DYNAMO MOSCOW STUMBLE.

text.p: Russian champions Spartak Moscow kept their nose in front of Rotor Volgograd on Saturday, cruising past lowly Tyumen 2-0 at home while Rotor, one point behind, crushed Zenit St Petersburg 3-0 in Volgograd.
Third-placed Dynamo Moscow slipped back, dropping two points at home in a 1-1 draw with Baltika Kaliningrad to fall four points behind city rivals Spartak.
Spartak and Dynamo both have a game in hand over Rotor. Dynamo take on Krylya Sovietov on Wednesday in the delayed game. The leaders face Torpedo Moscow.
Cupwinners Lokomotiv Moscow kept up their bid to prevent the last third of the season becoming a three-team affair.
They moved into fourth place, four points behind Dynamo, with a 3-1 win away at struggling fellow railway club Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod.
Moscow's army side CSKA, began to claw their way out of the relegation zone with a 3-2 win at Zhemchuzhina.
The Sochi side face a league inquiry on Monday into allegations of match-fixing in their last home match, against Chernomorets Novorossiisk.
